follow-up time: Until first diagnosis of ASD, death, migration, or December 31, 2011
cohort: 2,697,315 singleton live births in Sweden from January 1, 1982, through December 31, 2010
finding: While the initial analysis showed an association between cesarean section and ASD, this association disappeared after adjusting for familial confounding factors using a sibling control design.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean section was not associated with ASD in the sibling control analysis, while emergency CS was significantly associated with ASD in the partially adjusted analysis but not in the fully adjusted model.
